result.summary:
Replaced the FAILed guard-clause shape in both makeStaffAddHandler (originally lines 91-105) and makeStaffRemoveHandler (originally lines 165-179) of apps/bot/src/handlers/staff.ts with the re-gated design's single-try-block shape: both branches now unconditionally await resolveLangForTg(db, Number(targetUser.tgId)) and compose `body` from the same catalog key + .replace("{event}", event.title) before any Bot API call is made. Inside that same try block, the branch on targetUser.blocked now only selects which Bot API method to call: `await ctx.api.getMe()` (result discarded, no argument, no side effect) for blocked, setting notificationFailed = true unconditionally immediately after; `await ctx.api.sendMessage(Number(targetUser.tgId), body)` unchanged for not-blocked. The existing single `catch { notificationFailed = true; }` wraps the whole try block unchanged, covering unexpected failures on either path (a no-op re-assignment on the already-true blocked path if getMe() itself throws). apps/bot/src/domain/user.ts was not touched -- its blocked projection on UserWithTelegram/getUserByTgUsername from the first implementation is already correct per the design and was out of scope for this rework. No file outside apps/bot/src/handlers/staff.ts was modified.
